draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.69, the 215th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 10th of 10 at QB. He went 133rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (215th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (85th percentile). College production: 2,830 passing yards in 2020, 5th of 10 QBs in his class with stats.
